variants.headline: Request for more shipping refused
variants.body: The home world has refused the colony's request for more shipping. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Home world declines route expansion request
variants.body: A colonial request for additional shipping has been rejected by the home world. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: No assent to the colony's shipping plea
variants.body: The colony's plea for more shipping has been refused. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
